req.title: Delete task
req.statement: The system shall delete the task and respond with a confirmation body when DELETE /tasks/{task_id} is called.

doc.reasoning: The test suite is designed to validate the DELETE /tasks/{task_id} endpoint, ensuring it behaves correctly under various conditions. The tests cover positive, negative, and boundary cases to ensure robustness against common mutations.

tests.name: test_delete_task_positive
preconditions: A task with ID 1 exists in the database.
tests.executable:
from app.main import app
from fastapi.testclient import TestClient

client = TestClient(app)

# Precondition: Create a task to ensure it exists
response = client.post("/tasks/", json={"title": "Test Task", "description": "Test Description", "completed": False})
assert response.status_code == 201
created_task_id = response.json()["id"]

# Action: Delete the task
response = client.delete(f"/tasks/{created_task_id}")

# Expected: The task is deleted successfully
assert response.status_code == 204

tests.name: test_delete_task_negative
preconditions: No task with ID 999 exists in the database.
expected: The response contains an error message indicating the task was not found.
tests.executable:
from app.main import app
from fastapi.testclient import TestClient

client = TestClient(app)

# Action: Attempt to delete a non-existent task
response = client.delete("/tasks/999")

# Expected: The task does not exist, so a 404 error is returned
assert response.status_code == 404
assert response.json()["detail"] == "Task with id 999 not found"

tests.name: test_delete_task_boundary
preconditions: A task with ID 1 exists in the database.
actions: Send a DELETE request to /tasks/1 again.
expected: The first response status code is 204.
The second response status code is 404.
tests.executable:
from app.main import app
from fastapi.testclient import TestClient

client = TestClient(app)

# Precondition: Create a task to ensure it exists
response = client.post("/tasks/", json={"title": "Boundary Task", "description": "Boundary Description", "completed": False})
assert response.status_code == 201
created_task_id = response.json()["id"]

# Action: Delete the task
response = client.delete(f"/tasks/{created_task_id}")

# Expected: The task is deleted successfully
assert response.status_code == 204

# Action: Attempt to delete the same task again
response = client.delete(f"/tasks/{created_task_id}")

# Expected: The task no longer exists, so a 404 error is returned
assert response.status_code == 404
assert response.json()["detail"] == f"Task with id {created_task_id} not found"
